activities.title: Romantic Stroll Through Rambagh Palace Gardens
activities.description: Begin your romantic Jaipur escape at the 'Jewel of Jaipur,' Rambagh Palace. Imagine yourselves hand-in-hand as you wander through its opulent gardens, admire the intricate architecture, and soak in the royal ambiance. Enjoy a leisurely morning coffee or light refreshments together, truly immersing yourselves in the grandeur of this historic setting.
activities.booking_notes: Reservations recommended for specific dining experiences.

activities.title: Intimate Rajasthani Lunch at Hotel Narain Niwas Palace
activities.description: Share a delightful traditional Rajasthani lunch together in the charming, heritage setting of Hotel Narain Niwas Palace. This boutique hotel offers a romantic glimpse into Jaipur's aristocratic past with its unique decor and serene courtyards.
activities.booking_notes: Walk-ins generally accepted, but reservations are advisable during peak season.

activities.title: Enchanting Afternoon at Jai Mahal Palace Gardens
activities.description: Continue your palace exploration with a visit to Jai Mahal Palace. Lose yourselves in its expansive Mughal gardens, admire the stunning Indo-Saracenic architecture together, and perhaps share a refreshing beverage in its elegant lounge, creating picture-perfect moments.

activities.title: Romantic Dinner at Rajmahal Palace RAAS Jaipur
activities.description: Conclude your magical day with an unforgettable, luxurious dinner at the exquisite Rajmahal Palace RAAS Jaipur. Experience fine dining together in a setting that masterfully blends historic charm with contemporary elegance, promising a truly memorable culinary journey.
activities.booking_notes: Highly recommended to book a table in advance, especially for dinner.

activities.title: Discover Umaid Mahal's Artistic Charm Together
activities.description: Start your day exploring the unique heritage architecture and intricate details of Umaid Mahal, a charming boutique hotel. Its traditional Rajasthani design offers a beautiful backdrop for you to discover together, showcasing local craftsmanship.
activities.location: Umaid Mahal-A heritage Style Boutique Hotel
